# cmribio

This package contains functions and reporting templates used for
standard analysis and reporting for bioinformatics and biostatistics
projects.

## Installation

You can install the development version of cmribio from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("jmvarberg/cmribio")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`create_bcb_report()`](https://jmvarberg.github.io/cmribio/reference/create_bcb_report.md)
  : Generate a standard analysis report from template in the current
  directory.
- [`init_proj()`](https://jmvarberg.github.io/cmribio/reference/init_proj.md)
  : Initialize Project Directory
